neighbours.label: the local tier of government: 'local' or 'municipal' meaning sub-national administration (local level, local authorities, collectivités locales)
fire: The reform gives councils more control over spending at the local level.
Les collectivités locales gèrent les écoles primaires et les routes.
Funding for libraries now comes mostly from local authorities.
The minister wants decisions on housing taken at the local level.
In the 2019 local elections, turnout fell to a record low.
Les élus locaux réclament davantage de moyens pour les communes.
Power was transferred from the capital to local governments.
Disaster planning should begin at the local level, not in the capital.
quiet: The reform gives the ministry more control over spending at the national level.
Les grandes entreprises gèrent leurs usines et leurs routes privées.
Funding for libraries now comes mostly from private donors.
The children bought ice cream at the local shop after school.
In the 2019 general election, turnout fell to a record low.
Les habitants réclament davantage de bus pour le quartier.
Our local beach gets very crowded on sunny weekends.
Disaster planning should begin early, before the storm season.
